Most of the architects of October 7 attacks have been killed, says Netanyahu
items.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Sunday that Israel is close to finishing a key war aim in Gaza: killing the planners of the October 7 attacks. items.title: 'The Strike Hit Right Above Us': A Night Under Russian Bombs In Dobropillya
items.description: Russia is preparing to assault the city of Dobropillya, according to Ukraine’s military. Located a few kilometers from the front line, the city is burning and being destroyed by bombs, artillery, and drones. Despite daily shelling, some civilians flatly refuse to leave and remain in Dobropillya.
